description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_AssignGlobal, which provides a method assignGlobal for assigning a global variable within the Smarty templating system. The class facilitates the assignment of global variables with optional caching control and supports nested template objects.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_AssignGlobal
classes.description: Provides a method to assign global variables in Smarty templates, supporting nested template objects and cache control.

methods.name: assignGlobal
methods.description: Assigns a global variable in Smarty, optionally marking it for no-cache and propagating to nested templates.
